facts.business: SPA Capital Services Limited is a Non-Banking Financial Company (NBFC) engaged in providing loans, making investments, and holding securities as stock-in-trade.

auditor.name: Dhana & Associates
auditor.emphasis_or_qualification: Non-compliance with Sections 185 and 186 of the Companies Act, 2013 regarding interest not charged on loans/advances; loans granted without stipulated repayment terms; Property, Plant and Equipment not physically verified during the period.

key_risks: Non-compliance with Sections 185 and 186 of the Companies Act, 2013
Loans granted without stipulated repayment terms or interest
Property, Plant and Equipment not physically verified during the period
Absence of loan agreements for certain loans
facts.related_party_note: The Company has not complied with the provisions of Sections 185 and 186 of the Companies Act, 2013 in respect of few loans granted, investments made and guarantees and securities provided, as interest on loans and advances given has not been charged by the company.
